messages.content: What was the full name king of England in 1800?

function.name: monarch_getMonarchOfYear
function.description: Retrieve the monarch of a specific location during a specified year. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The location (e.g., country) whose monarch needs to be found.

year.description: The year to search the monarch.

fullName.description: If true, returns the full name and title of the monarch.

message.reasoning:
The user asks "What was the full name king of England in 1800?" They want the full name of the King of England in 1800.

We need to retrieve the monarch of England in 1800 with full name. Use the tool `monarch_getMonarchOfYear` with location="England" or maybe "United Kingdom"? But historically, in 1800 it would still have been Great Britain until 1801 when United Kingdom formed. So we can use location="Great Britain". However they asked specifically "king of England", but it's effectively same as Great Britain's monarchy at that time. We'll call the function with location="England" if accepted; else "Great Britain".

Let's try calling with location="England" because that's what they ask. Provide year=1800, fullName=true.
